description: Return what each of the catalog's five health signals measures and, for each signal, its bands in order, each with a one-line meaning and its published cut-point. The text is the same as the catalog's methodology page (/methodology), built from the same source. Takes no arguments. Reads no catalog data and returns no project. Read-only. Serves catalog schema v1.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Any argument is refused as an invalid argument.

name: get_methodology
